meaning: Officer grade abbreviations (Assistant Executive Engineer and above) used to refer to the company officer on site.
example_line: AEE (P) sahab ko inform kiya, GGS-1 flare pilot off since morning, gas venting.
source_hint: ONGC grade structure; OIL grades differ

meaning: Breakdown of equipment, or breakdown maintenance.
example_line: Pump in B/D, fitter repairing belt with drive still connected, LOTO nahi kiya.

meaning: Behaviour based safety observation programme; BBS cards are one of the channels UA/UC reports arrive through.
example_line: BBS observation: fitter using grinder without guard near ETP, SOP nahi follow kar raha.

meaning: Bottom hole assembly of drill collars, stabilisers and bit handled on the rig floor.
example_line: BHA handling on rig floor, pickup line frayed, helper standing in line of fire.

meaning: Central Industrial Security Force, which guards gates of PSU installations.
example_line: CISF gate allowed tanker without spark arrestor into OCS, checking nahi hua.

meaning: Carbon monoxide, from engine exhaust or fire, a confined space and DG room hazard; not to be confused with C/O changeover.
example_line: DG set running inside closed shed at rig camp, CO alarm nahi hai, exhaust andar hi aa raha.
source_hint: generic oil & gas / confined space practice

meaning: Cathodic protection system preventing external corrosion of buried pipelines.
example_line: CP station at SV-2 not working since 2 months, TLP reading not taken.

meaning: Entry into a tank, vessel, pit or other confined space, which requires a separate permit, gas test and standby person.
example_line: Two helpers inside crude tank T-2 for sludge cleaning, CSE permit nahi tha, koi standby nahi.

meaning: Central tank farm where crude from field installations is stored before despatch.
example_line: CTF tank T-3 roof platform railing missing, gauging chal raha tha.

meaning: Coiled tubing unit used for well intervention, usually with high pressure pumping and nitrogen units.
example_line: CTU job at well 9, HP hose without whip check, injector head ke niche log khade.

meaning: Electrical distribution board or motor control panel.
example_line: DB cover open near well site camp, wires exposed, barish me paani ja raha andar.

meaning: Dry chemical powder type extinguisher, the most common portable extinguisher on Indian installations.
example_line: DCP 9 kg extinguisher near DG set pressure gauge in red zone, refill due since 2024.

meaning: Diesel generator set supplying power at rigs, camps and installations.
example_line: DG set exhaust pipe near HSD drum, running without cover, canopy door open.

meaning: Driving licence of the driver or operator.
example_line: Hydra operator DL expired, RTO renewal pending, still operating at pipe yard.

meaning: Drill pipe, and by extension tubular handling on catwalk and rig floor.
example_line: DP racking on catwalk, pipe rolling, koi stopper nahi, helper beech me khada.

meaning: Company engineer responsible for a contract or job, who signs permits and supervises the contractor.
example_line: Excavation on P/L ROW at KM 12 started without informing EIC, kisi ko pata nahi tha.

meaning: Electric overhead travelling crane in workshops and pump houses.
example_line: EOT crane hook limit switch bypass kiya hua, operator ground se chala raha bina signalman.

meaning: Site emergency and disaster management plan, including assembly points and drills.
example_line: Contractor crew at well site ERP se unaware, assembly point nahi pata, mock drill kabhi nahi hua.

meaning: Emergency shutdown system or valve that isolates the process on high pressure, fire or manual trip.
example_line: ESD push button at GGS inlet manifold cover broken, SDV kept in manual, bypass position me hai.

meaning: Electrical submersible pump installed downhole, with high voltage surface cable and panel; not the emergency shutdown ESD.
example_line: ESP well cable joint exposed near wellhead, VSD panel door open, paani bhara hua.

meaning: Effluent treatment plant handling produced water and oily effluent.
example_line: ETP sludge pit uncovered, night me light nahi, fencing toot gayi.

meaning: Fire and Safety department of the installation.
example_line: F&S clearance nahi liya for cutting job at CTF tank dyke, fire tender bhi nahi tha.

meaning: Injury needing only first aid, the lowest recordable outcome class.
example_line: FA case: minor cut on hand while handling GI sheet at store, gloves nahi pehne the.

meaning: Portable fire extinguisher required at hot work and hydrocarbon handling locations.
example_line: Hot work at pump house going on, FE nahi tha nearby, jo tha uska expiry last year.
source_hint: OISD-STD-189 fire fighting equipment for rigs and production installations

meaning: Flameproof (explosion protected) electrical fitting required in a classified hazardous area.
example_line: Non-FLP hand lamp used inside tank dyke area, cable joint open, Zone 1 area hai.

meaning: Fire resistant coverall issued for work in hydrocarbon areas; dangri is the common Hinglish word for any coverall.
example_line: Welder wearing normal cotton shirt, FRC nahi, sparks near separator drain.

meaning: Fixed or portable gas detection, usually flammable and H2S, at process areas.
example_line: Fixed gas detector at compressor shed showing fault, bypass in panel, koi portable GD nahi.

meaning: Group gathering station where well fluids from several wells are separated (ONGC term).
example_line: GGS-4 inlet manifold area oil spillage, drain choke, slippery, koi cleaning nahi.

meaning: Gate pass or entry permit for persons and vehicles entering an installation.
example_line: Casual labour inside CTF bina GP, contractor supervisor ko bhi pata nahi tha.

meaning: Toxic flammable gas present in sour crude and gas, dangerous at low ppm.
example_line: H2S smell near OCS-1 ETP pit, koi detector nahi laga tha, workers bina mask kaam kar rahe.

meaning: High potential near miss or incident that could realistically have caused a fatality or serious injury.
example_line: HiPo NM: hydra boom touched 11 KV line near GGS gate, operator ne dekha nahi.

meaning: Documented hazard identification and risk assessment exercise for an activity or installation.
example_line: New HP jetting job at ETP started without HIRA, SOP bhi nahi hai is job ka.
source_hint: OISD-RP-206; common Indian PSU HSE practice

meaning: Heavy motor vehicle licence class; LMV is the light vehicle class, insufficient for tankers and trailers.
example_line: Driver of water bowser only LMV licence, HMV nahi hai, 10 KL tanker chala raha.

meaning: High pressure line, hose or jetting operation.
example_line: HP jetting at ETP without face shield, lance without dead man switch, hose purana.

meaning: High speed diesel stored and handled at rigs and installations.
example_line: HSD drum decanting near DG with mobile in hand, spillage on ground, no bund.

meaning: Health, safety and environment function or department.
example_line: HSE audit point pending: FLP light fitting near GGS-2 separator abhi tak nahi badla.

meaning: High tension (or low tension) electrical supply, lines and panels.
example_line: Hydra parked under 33 KV HT line near ROW, boom raised, koi barricade nahi.

meaning: Permit specifically for spark or flame producing work such as welding, grinding, gas cutting in a hydrocarbon area.
example_line: HWP issued for grinding near test separator but gas test column blank, fire watch bhi nahi tha.

meaning: Person in charge of a shift, rig, site or section.
example_line: Shift I/C allowed hot work near flare pit without gas test, LEL meter charge nahi tha.

meaning: Statutory person in charge of an oil mine installation, who owns the permit system and emergency plan.
example_line: IM not present at site during BOP nipple-up, permit signed by junior only.

meaning: In-vehicle monitoring or tracking device recording speed, harsh braking and location.
example_line: Contractor tanker without IVMS entered CTF, overspeeding noticed at gate.
source_hint: IOGP Report 459 Driving; ONGC IVMS/VTS rollout

meaning: Journey management plan for road trips, covering route, timing, rest and night driving restrictions.
example_line: Night movement of crew vehicle to well site without JMP, driver alone 6 hours continuous.
source_hint: IOGP Report 459 Driving; unverified as written abbreviation in OIL/ONGC reports

meaning: Step-by-step written breakdown of a job with hazards and precautions, usually attached to the permit.
example_line: Rigging up of WO rig mast at well site, JSA nahi bana, crew ko koi briefing nahi di.

meaning: Kilogram per square centimetre, the pressure unit written in Indian oil field reports along with psi.
example_line: Test separator running at 12 ksc, PSV set 10 ksc but isolated, gauge nahi dikh raha.

meaning: Percentage of the lower explosive limit of flammable gas measured before hot work or entry.
example_line: Grinding near flare KOD started, LEL reading nahi liya, permit me gas test column blank.

meaning: Physical locking and tagging of an energy isolation point so equipment cannot be re-energised during work.
example_line: Fitter opened SRP gearbox for repair, LOTO nahi kiya, panel me sirf switch off tha.

meaning: LPG cylinders used in camp kitchens and mess, or for cutting.
example_line: LPG cylinder in mess kitchen at well site camp, hose cracked, regulator loose.

meaning: Company life saving rules, usually adapted from IOGP, whose violation is tagged in reports.
example_line: LSR violation: driver on phone while driving pipe trailer inside CTF, speed bhi zyada.
source_hint: IOGP Report 459; ONGC Life Saving Rules

meaning: Injury causing the person to miss at least one shift, reportable under mines regulations.
example_line: LTI free days board not updated since last month, contractor injuries count nahi hote.

meaning: Machine, written as M/C in Indian maintenance shorthand.
example_line: Grinding M/C guard removed, wheel cracked, operator bina goggles.

meaning: Formal review and approval before any temporary or permanent change to equipment, process or procedure.
example_line: Temporary hose connected from HP line to test separator without MOC, EIC ko nahi bataya.

meaning: Chemical hazard data sheet that should be available where a chemical is stored or used.
example_line: Demulsifier drums stored near GGS store, MSDS not available, label bhi fade ho gaya.

meaning: Injury needing treatment by a doctor beyond first aid but without lost time.
example_line: MTC reported: eye irritation after chemical splash at ETP, goggles nahi the, MSDS unknown.

meaning: Nominal bore pipe size, the standard way Indian reports state pipe diameter.
example_line: 6 NB flowline flange bolts missing two, gasket exposed, line live hai.

meaning: Near miss, an event that could have caused injury or damage but did not.
example_line: NM: DP stand slipped from fingerboard during racking, derrickman just niche khada tha.

meaning: No objection certificate or clearance from another department before starting work in its area.
example_line: Excavation near HT cable at GCS done without electrical NOC, cable exposed ho gaya.

meaning: Overhead electrical line or crossing.
example_line: Scaffold pipe being lifted near O/H LT line at GGS store, clearance 1 m only.

meaning: Oxygen percentage measured before confined space entry, normally required between 19.5 and 23.5 percent.
example_line: O2 test not done before tank entry, sirf LEL check kiya, blower bhi nahi laga tha.

meaning: Oil collecting station where well fluids are gathered and separated (Oil India term).
example_line: OCS-2 tank dyke drain valve open, oily water bahar ja raha, gas smell bhi aa rahi.

meaning: Site medical facility, medical officer and ambulance.
example_line: OHC ambulance at rig site tyre puncture since 3 days, driver bhi nahi hai.
source_hint: Oil Mines Regulations 2017 (medical facilities); Factories Act usage

meaning: Government safety directorate for the Indian oil industry whose standards and audits apply to the installation.
example_line: OISD audit observation: PSV of test separator not tested since 2023, tag missing.

meaning: Pipeline or flowline carrying crude, gas or water under pressure.
example_line: Leak on 6 inch P/L near village, crude ground pe, barricade nahi, log dekhne aa rahe.

meaning: Regulator that licenses storage of petroleum, explosives and pressure vessels.
example_line: HSD storage at drill site around 5 KL, PESO licence limit se zyada, dyke bhi nahi hai.

meaning: Pressure (or temperature, level) gauge; a missing or broken gauge means pressure is not being monitored.
example_line: PG on HP separator glass broken, reading nahi dikh raha, operator andaza laga raha.

meaning: Preventive maintenance schedule; an overdue PM is a cue that a control may be ineffective.
example_line: Hydra PM due since 4 months, brake weak, still used for pipe unloading.

meaning: Helmet, shoes, goggles, gloves, harness and similar personal protection worn by the worker.
example_line: Helper working at cellar pit edge without PPE, safety belt nahi pehna, chappal me tha.

meaning: Parts per million, the unit used for toxic gas readings such as H2S.
example_line: H2S 15 ppm at wellhead cellar during sampling, operator without BA set, alarm nahi baja.
source_hint: Oil Mines Regulations 2017 sour gas limits

meaning: Written authorisation from the installation or area in-charge before hot, cold or entry work starts, recording isolations and gas test.
example_line: Contractor party welding at OCS-3 flowline header, PTW nahi tha, EIC ko bhi pata nahi.
source_hint: OISD-STD-105 work permit system; Oil Mines Regulations 2017

meaning: Pipeline right of way strip where third party digging and encroachment are the main hazards.
example_line: Brick kiln encroachment on P/L ROW at KM 18, tractor movement over the line daily.

meaning: Rotary table and the rig floor around it; RT also means radiography test in NDT context.
example_line: Roughneck hand near RT while making connection, tong line under tension.

meaning: Shutdown of a line, plant or electrical supply taken as isolation before work.
example_line: Flowline flange opened bina S/D, sirf wing valve close, THP 20 ksc tha.

meaning: Serious injury or fatality potential, a classification tag rather than something field staff normally write.
example_line: SIF-p flagged: crew working at 8 m on mast without harness anchor, safety line nahi thi.
source_hint: IOGP / SIF precursor literature; unverified in Indian field reports

meaning: Two or more jobs going on at the same time in the same area, each creating hazards for the other.
example_line: SIMOPS at GGS-2: scaffold erection above while flowline hot tapping going on niche, koi coordination nahi.

meaning: Crane safe load indicator that warns or cuts out on overload.
example_line: Hydra SLI not working, load chart bhi nahi hai, 5 ton lift attempted with 2 slings.
source_hint: Oil Mines Regulations 2017 lifting machinery; DGMS circulars on ASLI

meaning: Designated safety officer for the installation or contract.
example_line: SO ne site visit kiya, scaffold without tag, rokne ke baad bhi party ne kaam continue kiya.

meaning: Written standard procedure for an operation or maintenance task.
example_line: Operator bypassed SOP and opened separator drain manually while THP 30 ksc tha.

meaning: Sucker rod (beam) pumping unit on a well, with rotating counterweights and moving horse head.
example_line: SRP well 11 horse head guard missing, counterweight rotating, helper paas khada tha.

meaning: Any worker's authority to stop an unsafe job, also the verb phrase reporting that work was stopped.
example_line: Stop work by SO, kaam roka gaya, scaffold without ladder and toe board at tank T-3.
source_hint: IOGP Report 459 introduction; ONGC/OIL SWA practice

meaning: Maximum load a sling, hook, crane or lifting tackle is rated to carry, normally stamped or tagged on it.
example_line: Chain pulley block used for pulling ESP cable, SWL marking nahi tha, hook latch missing.

meaning: Transformer, written T/F in Indian electrical shorthand; substation is S/S.
example_line: T/F yard fencing gate open at GGS, oil leak from T/F, fire sand bucket nahi.

meaning: Short pre-job briefing given to the crew before starting work.
example_line: Night shift TBT nahi hua, crew directly BHA handling pe chala gaya rig floor par.
source_hint: common Indian oil & gas HSE practice; OISD-RP-206

meaning: Top drive system on a drilling rig, rotating and hoisting the drill string.
example_line: TDS torque wrench line snapped on rig 5, hook load high, koi guard nahi tha.

meaning: Tubing head (or casing head) pressure at the wellhead, the main indicator of stored pressure energy.
example_line: Sample point opened at THP 40 ksc without needle valve, direct 1 inch valve use kiya.

meaning: Tool pusher, the rig in-charge for drilling operations; TP also means test pressure in piping context.
example_line: TP not on floor during tripping, driller alone, derrickman without fall arrestor.

meaning: Periodic inspection and certification of lifting gear, cranes, pressure vessels or scaffolds by an approved external agency.
example_line: Hydra sling used for BOP lifting, TPI certificate expired since March, colour tag missing.
source_hint: Oil Mines Regulations 2017; ONGC/OIL contract clauses

meaning: Underground or buried cable or pipeline, a hazard for excavation.
example_line: JCB digging on ROW at Ch 34, U/G OFC and 8 inch P/L route not marked, trial pit nahi.

meaning: Unsafe act by a person, the report type prefix for behaviour observations.
example_line: UA: helper standing under suspended load during pipe unloading at pipe yard.

meaning: Unsafe physical condition of equipment or workplace, the report type prefix for condition observations.
example_line: UC: cellar pit at well 5 open without cover, night me light bhi nahi.

meaning: Workover operation or rig; note WO also means work order in contract context.
example_line: W/O rig moving on narrow village road, mast section without escort vehicle, night time.

meaning: Wireline or slickline unit used for well logging and downhole tools under pressure.
example_line: WL job at well 3, lubricator pressure test nahi hua, wire path me helper khada.

meaning: Wellhead valve assembly controlling flow from the well.
example_line: X-mas tree master valve stem leaking gas, wing valve bhi passing, cellar me gas.

meaning: A solid steel flange used to seal off the end of a piping system.
example_line: Manifold drain left open without blind flange installed.

meaning: Safety device used in electrical installations to prevent shock by detecting leakage to earth.
example_line: Temporary camp power supply bypassed ELCB.

meaning: Portable device for discharging chemicals to put out small fires.
example_line: Hot work chal raha tha bina fire extinguisher stand-by ke.

meaning: High-capacity, stationary water/foam jet used for firefighting in terminals.
example_line: GGS water monitor rotation jammed due to rust.

meaning: Safety device in oxy-fuel welding/cutting to prevent flame from traveling back to cylinders.
example_line: Flash back arrestor missing on torch end of DA cylinder.

meaning: Portable device to measure presence of explosive or toxic gases.
example_line: Confined space entry kiya without gas detector reading.

meaning: A rail fixed to posts on a platform or stairway to prevent falls.
example_line: Mud tank stair handrail broken by hydra impact.

meaning: Valve that allows fluid to flow in one direction only.
example_line: Gas lift line NRV passing backwards during shutdown.

meaning: Fail-safe valve designed to open and relieve excess pressure from vessels.
example_line: Compressor discharge PSV calibration overdue.

meaning: Self-Contained Breathing Apparatus used in toxic gas environments.
example_line: Rescue team SCBA cylinder pressure found below 100 bar during drill.

merge_conflicts.dropped: Breathing apparatus worn in H2S or oxygen deficient atmosphere.

merge_conflicts.dropped: SCBA set at GCS control room cylinder pressure 80 bar only, mask strap toota hua.

meaning: A solid piece of metal inserted between two flanges to provide positive isolation.
example_line: Spade insert kiya without LOTO verification.

meaning: A specific brand of SUV/Pickup heavily utilized as a utility vehicle in Indian O&G fields.
example_line: Bolero parked inside hazardous area without valid vehicle pass.

meaning: Critical well control equipment installed on the wellhead to prevent release of well fluids.
example_line: BOP ram function test delayed by driller shift change.

merge_conflicts.kept: Critical well control equipment installed on the wellhead to prevent release of well fluids.
merge_conflicts.dropped: Well control equipment on the wellhead used to close the well during drilling or workover.

merge_conflicts.dropped: BOP test nahi hua after nipple-up, IBOP bhi rig floor pe nahi mila, drilling start kar diya.

meaning: A mobile tank used for transporting water, diesel, or chemicals to the rig site.
example_line: Diesel bowser decanting without earth pit connection.

meaning: A spool on the drawworks used to pull lines for tongs.
example_line: Cathead chain broken during heavy pull.
source_hint: Legacy rig equipment, still common in older PSU workover rigs.

meaning: A lifting mechanism using a chain, operated manually to lift heavy loads.
example_line: Using damaged chain block to lift mud pump fluid end.

meaning: System of valves and chokes used to lower the pressure from the wellhead.
example_line: Choke manifold valve body showing severe erosion.

meaning: U-shaped load-bearing connecting device used in rigging.
example_line: Local make D-shackle used without SWL marking.

meaning: Component of an electricity supply system that divides an electrical power feed into subsidiary circuits.
example_line: DB box cover missing near shale shaker motor.

meaning: The primary hoisting machinery on a drilling rig.
example_line: Drawworks primary brake slipping while lowering drill string.

meaning: Hinged mechanism wrapped around drill pipe or casing to facilitate lifting.
example_line: Elevator latch nahi laga tha properly while pulling out.

meaning: Portable electrical board to provide multiple sockets from one source.
example_line: Industrial plug na hoke domestic extension board was used in OCS.

meaning: Another brand/type of mobile pick-and-carry crane popular in India, similar to Hydra but slightly different design.
example_line: Farana crane outrigger not fully extended on soft soil.
source_hint: Indian construction and O&G site vernacular.

meaning: Elevated vertical structure or horizontal pit used to safely burn off unusable gas.
example_line: Flare stack pilot burner extinguished, raw gas venting observed.

meaning: Pipe carrying fluid from the wellhead to the gathering station.
example_line: Oil leak from 4 inch flowline near village crossing.

meaning: Equipment consisting of gas cylinders, hoses, and a torch used to cut metal.
example_line: Gas cutting set hoses not having jubilee clamps, tied with wire.

meaning: A framework of metal bars used as a walking surface on platforms and rigs.
example_line: Monkey board grating loosely fitted, tripping hazard.

meaning: Handheld power tool used for grinding and cutting metal.
example_line: Contractor using angle grinder without wheel guard in scrap yard.

meaning: High-intensity temporary lighting used for night operations on rigs.
example_line: Non-flameproof halogen light used near shale shaker area during night shift.

meaning: Vessel that uses heat to break oil-water emulsions in production facilities.
example_line: Heater treater fire tube inspection pending since 2 years.

meaning: Locally manufactured pick-and-carry mobile crane, widely used but prone to tipping.
example_line: Hydra se casing pipe utha raha tha, tag line use nahi kiya.
source_hint: Common Indian O&G field vernacular; OISD alerts on hydra crane incidents.

meaning: Generic term used for any backhoe loader or earthmoving equipment.
example_line: JCB working near live flowline without spotter presence.
source_hint: Common Hinglish usage in civil/pipeline works.

merge_conflicts.kept: Generic term used for any backhoe loader or earthmoving equipment.
merge_conflicts.dropped: Brand name used generically for any backhoe loader or excavator, common in pipeline ROW and civil work.

meaning: A suspended seat or platform used for working at heights, often makeshift in India.
example_line: Painter jhoola par tha without anchoring life line to permanent structure.

meaning: A multi-sided pipe that transfers rotary motion to the drill string.
example_line: Kelly bushing unseated while circulating.

meaning: A specialized winch certified for hoisting personnel in a harness or basket.
example_line: Utility air winch used instead of man riding winch for mast inspection.

meaning: Platform high in the derrick where the derrickman handles the top of the drill pipe.
example_line: Derrickman going to monkey board without double lanyard harness.
source_hint: Standard rig terminology / Oil Mines Regulations.

meaning: A shallow hole drilled under the rig floor to temporarily hold the next joint of drill pipe.
example_line: Mousehole cover missing on rig floor, open hole hazard.

meaning: Large reciprocating pump used to circulate drilling fluid.
example_line: Mud pump relief valve isolated intentionally during high pressure operation.

meaning: Equipment used to insert a pipeline pig into a pressurized pipeline.
example_line: Opening pig launcher door without bleeding pressure fully.

meaning: Equipment used to safely receive and remove a pipeline pig.
example_line: Pig receiver vent valve found choked during pigging operation.

meaning: Tracked excavator, commonly referred to by the legacy brand name.
example_line: Poclain chain slipped on slushy rig approach road.
source_hint: Field vernacular in Assam/North East O&G operations.

meaning: Hydraulically operated tool used to spin and torque tubulars.
example_line: Power tong hydraulic hose burst, oil spread on rig floor.

meaning: A hole in the rig floor where the kelly is temporarily stored.
example_line: Rathole area housekeeping poor, slippery mud present.

meaning: Temporary structure to support work crew and materials.
example_line: Scaffolding built with bamboo instead of metallic pipes at heater treater.

meaning: Pressure vessel used for separating well fluids into gas and liquid phases.
example_line: Separator liquid level high alarm bypassed in OCS.

meaning: Vibrating screens used to separate drill cuttings from circulating drilling mud.
example_line: Worker cleaning shale shaker screen without hand gloves.

meaning: Wedge-shaped pieces of metal with teeth used to hold the drill string in the rotary table.
example_line: Roughneck slipped while handling casing slips on rig floor.

meaning: A temporary platform in the derrick used by personnel to guide casing into the well.
example_line: Stabbing board tie-off rope damaged, fall hazard.

meaning: A rigid metal pipe that provides a pathway for drilling mud to travel up the derrick.
example_line: Standpipe manifold gauge showing zero while pump is running.

meaning: Artificial lift pumping unit on the surface of an oil well.
example_line: SRP counterweight guard missing, unguarded rotating parts.

meaning: A manually operated wire rope hoist used for pulling and tensioning.
example_line: Tirfor se BOP align kar rahe the, handle bent.

meaning: Large wrenches used on the rig floor to make up or break out drill pipe.
example_line: Manual tong jaw slipped during make up, hitting floorman leg.

meaning: A mechanical device on a rig that provides clockwise torque to the drill string to drill.
example_line: Top drive link tilt mechanism got stuck midway.

meaning: Air or hydraulically operated utility winch on the rig floor.
example_line: Tugger winch wire rope condition poor and frayed.

meaning: A tank truck equipped with a heavy-duty vacuum for sucking up oil spills or sludge.
example_line: Vacuum truck suction hose leaked spilling crude oil in cellar pit.

meaning: Synthetic lifting strap used to lift fragile or regular loads without damage.
example_line: Web sling cut at edges used for motor lifting.

meaning: Power supply unit used for arc welding.
example_line: Welding machine earthing cable broken, risk of shock.

meaning: Truck or skid-mounted winch equipment used to lower tools into the wellbore.
example_line: Wireline unit positioned upwind but exhaust missing spark arrestor.
